pandas.api.typing.DataFrameGroupBy.sample

pandas 3.1.1 · GroupBy · method

Randomly select rows, entries or columns. Set random_state for repeatable results.

Call syntax

pd.api.typing.DataFrameGroupBy.sample(
    n=None,
    frac=None,
    replace=False,
    weights=None,
    random_state=None,
)
